query:
WITH m AS (SELECT e.*, r.marker_id AS known_marker,r.deprecated_at AS registry_deprecated,r.axis_or_dial FROM scoring.marker_event e LEFT JOIN scoring.marker_registry r ON (r.registry_version,r.marker_id)=(e.registry_version,e.marker_id)), eligible AS (SELECT * FROM m WHERE NOT is_candidate AND deprecated_at IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL AND known_marker IS NOT NULL AND registry_deprecated IS NULL AND nullif(btrim(evidence_ref),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(evidence_text),'') IS NOT NULL AND observed_at<=now())
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'marker_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM m),
 'marker_groups',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT scope,marker_id,is_candidate,is_verbatim,detector_version,source,count(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 ORDER BY 1,2,3) x),
 'marker_integrity',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('unknown_registry_marker',count(*) FILTER(WHERE known_marker IS NULL),'deprecated_registry',count(*) FILTER(WHERE registry_deprecated IS NOT NULL),'resolved',count(*) FILTER(WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL),'deprecated',count(*) FILTER(WHERE deprecated_at IS NOT NULL),'candidate',count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_candidate),'future',count(*) FILTER(WHERE observed_at>now()),'missing_evidence_ref',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(evidence_ref),'') IS NULL),'missing_evidence_text',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(evidence_text),'') IS NULL),'missing_collaborator',count(*) FILTER(WHERE scope='person' AND collaborator_user_id IS NULL),'missing_dyad',count(*) FILTER(WHERE scope='person' AND dyad_id IS NULL),'missing_dedup_key',count(*) FILTER(WHERE dedup_key IS NULL),'distinct_contacts',count(distinct contact_id),'distinct_accounts',count(distinct account_id),'distinct_collaborators',count(distinct collaborator_user_id)) FROM m),
 'marker_organization_mismatch',(SELECT count(*) FROM m LEFT JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id=m.contact_id LEFT JOIN public.companies a ON a.id=m.account_id WHERE c.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.organization_id AND m.contact_id IS NOT NULL OR a.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.organization_id AND m.account_id IS NOT NULL),
 'dedup_key_groups',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT organization_id,dedup_key FROM m WHERE dedup_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x),
 'same_event_marker_groups',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT organization_id,contact_id,account_id,marker_id,sense,evidence_ref FROM m GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 HAVING count(*)>1) x),
 'eligible_now',(SELECT count(*) FROM eligible),
 'snapshot_groups',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT entity_type,status,params_version,registry_version,count(*) AS n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE score IS NOT NULL) AS scored,count(*) FILTER(WHERE reliability IS NULL) AS reliability_null,min(reliability) AS reliability_min,max(reliability) AS reliability_max,count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict_allowed) AS verdict_true,count(distinct entity_id) AS entities,min(at) AS first_at,max(at) AS last_at FROM scoring.score_snapshot GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2) x),
 'snapshot_integrity',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('future',count(*) FILTER(WHERE at>now()),'score_out_of_range',count(*) FILTER(WHERE score<0 OR score>100),'reliability_out_of_range',count(*) FILTER(WHERE reliability<0 OR reliability>1),'dyad_entity_not_contact',count(*) FILTER(WHERE entity_type='dyad' AND entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM contact_id),'account_entity_not_account',count(*) FILTER(WHERE entity_type='account' AND entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM account_id),'verdict_without_score',count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict_allowed AND score IS NULL),'verdict_reliability_null_or_below_06',count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict_allowed AND (reliability IS NULL OR reliability<0.6))) FROM scoring.score_snapshot),
 'snapshot_duplicate_groups',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT entity_type,entity_id,snapshot_month,params_version,registry_version FROM scoring.score_snapshot GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 HAVING count(*)>1) x),
 'dyad_scored_without_eligible_at',(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot s WHERE s.entity_type='dyad' AND s.score IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eligible e WHERE e.scope='person' AND e.organization_id=s.organization_id AND e.contact_id=s.contact_id AND e.registry_version=s.registry_version AND e.observed_at<=s.at)),
 'dyad_verdict_under_5_distinct_refs',(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot s WHERE s.entity_type='dyad' AND s.verdict_allowed AND (SELECT count(distinct e.evidence_ref) FROM eligible e WHERE e.scope='person' AND e.organization_id=s.organization_id AND e.contact_id=s.contact_id AND e.registry_version=s.registry_version AND e.observed_at<=s.at)<5),
 'account_scored_without_any_eligible_at',(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot s WHERE s.entity_type='account' AND s.score IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eligible e WHERE e.organization_id=s.organization_id AND e.account_id=s.account_id AND e.registry_version=s.registry_version AND e.observed_at<=s.at)),
 'coverage_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='scoring' AND table_name='score_snapshot' AND column_name IN ('extraction_window','reliability','axes_or_dials','collaborator_user_id','dyad_id')) x),
 'snapshot_extraction_window_null',(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot WHERE extraction_window IS NULL),
 'snapshot_dials_coverage',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT entity_type,count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE axes_or_dials ? 'd_couverture') has_coverage_dial,count(*) FILTER(WHERE axes_or_dials ? 'd_couverture' AND axes_or_dials->'d_couverture'->>'value' IS NOT NULL) measured_coverage_dial FROM scoring.score_snapshot GROUP BY entity_type) x),
 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'active',count(*) FILTER(WHERE active),'no_observed_at',count(*) FILTER(WHERE observed_at IS NULL),'no_confidence',count(*) FILTER(WHERE confidence IS NULL),'no_decision_role',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(decision_role),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.account_contact_roles),
 'contact_population',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'tracked',count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_tracked),'merged',count(*) FILTER(WHERE merged_into_contact_id IS NOT NULL),'no_account',count(*) FILTER(WHERE company_id IS NULL),'no_owner',count(*) FILTER(WHERE owner_user_id IS NULL)) FROM public.contacts),
 'source_integrity',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('messages',count(*),'body_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE body_text IS NULL),'source_owner_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_owner_user_id IS NULL),'metadata_user_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE metadata->>'user_id' IS NULL),'contact_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE contact_id IS NULL)) FROM public.communication_messages),
 'flags',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)) FROM public.feature_flags f)
) AS integrity;
